question: What would happen to Totto Land if Big Mom got another craving for Wedding Cake and her hunger pangs aren't stopped? I don't think they could make that Wedding Cake again... -
answer: Definitely! You're so nice to worry about what will happen to Totto Land later, Akibee-san. Well, they'd probably have to flee Totto Land for a while, right? But the New World is a dangerous sea. Normally, one of the things the name "Big Mom" does is protect the family and the citizens. So even if a serious threat might come, they will stick with Big Mom. This is the harsh reality of living in Totto Land, a country protected by one of the "Great Powers"! (Seriously!)
name: Akibee
